product_philosophy: Money is organised so life can be lived: the screen shows what is free, not what is restricted.
Calm confidence: one clear answer, then the reasons on request.
Things already decided are put away carefully — held, sealed, built in — never hidden or scolded.
Clarity overrides poetic ambiguity: the function label and state carry meaning; editorial expression only enriches it.

marks: BOTANICAL MARK — a single stem with five leaves in muted rose
JURNL WORDMARK — high-contrast serif capitals, set vertically as a book spine beside the stem (official lockup) or horizontally with generous tracking
lockups: BOTANICAL MARK + JURNL (official vertical book-spine lockup)
BOTANICAL MARK + JURNL + descriptor FINANCIAL LIFE, BEAUTIFULLY ORGANIZED.
BOTANICAL MARK + JURNL + tagline PLAN TODAY. GROW FREELY.
placement_rules: The lockup is placed inside the composition as an object of the scene (carved, cast, printed, embossed) — never generic app chrome.
Do not default to a centred top-nav wordmark; an asymmetric placement is preferred when the composition supports it.
The descriptor or tagline lives in a secondary architectural zone, never beside the primary SAFE TO SPEND signal.
Legible at phone scale; never competes with the figure.
Never fabricate alternate letterforms. If a render mutates the mark or wordmark, repair it by compositing the official asset (recorded) or regenerate.

tagline_system: PLAN TODAY. GROW FREELY. — the promise; may be engraved, printed or set on a secondary surface.
FINANCIAL LIFE, BEAUTIFULLY ORGANIZED. — the descriptor; pairs with the lockup on maker’s plates, letterheads and labels.
MONEY IN SERVICE OF LIFE. — the belief; never rendered as UI copy on a functional screen unless the founder places it.
color_world: BONE / CREAM #F9F6EF and IVORY #F3EDE2 — the field
GREIGE #D2C8BA and TAUPE #B6A594 — material shadow, borders, quiet text
BLUSH #EBCFC8 and MUTED ROSE #C9949A — the brand mark and soft warmth, used sparingly
DEEP EMERALD #0F3D32 — the primary action and the one decisive figure
BURGUNDY #6E1F2D — seals, error, wax; never decoration
CHAMPAGNE #C6A676 — soft metal details only where they do a job (plates, rules, inlays)
OBSIDIAN — deep ink for type, never a dark theme
environment_world: natural light with a direction and a time of day
object_language: Financial things are organised physical objects: courses of stone, inlays, plates, rules, letters, seals, racks, folios.
Every object either carries data or frames it — no prop is decoration only.
Objects are made, not rendered: joints, grain, fold creases, tool marks.
typography_direction: DISPLAY: Instrument Serif character — fashion-condensed, high-contrast, used for the one figure and the large statement.
FUNCTIONAL: Barlow Semi Condensed character — tracked uppercase labels.
Type may be carved, inlaid, cast, printed or debossed — the medium is part of the meaning.
graphic_design_rules: One unmistakable SAFE TO SPEND figure; everything else is secondary by scale, value and material.
Editorial scale contrast between the figure and the hairline labels.
Custom information objects encode the data (area, thickness, inlay, seal), not charts pasted on.
Bespoke labels (plates, tabs, engraved captions) instead of generic pills.
Asymmetric branded framing; centring only where CENTER_STAGE requires the functional field to sit on the + axis.
Square-rounded controls only; no circular tappable buttons; the 5-item nav HOME · MONEY · + · PLAN · CREDIT is preserved exactly.
wit_definition: A smart visual idea that rewards attention: a meaningful metaphor or a subtle relationship between material and money (what is open vs held, metal vs stone, sealed vs released). Never jokes, cute copy or novelty UI.
anti_generic_rules: No card stacks over a pretty background.
No fintech dashboard grammar (KPI tiles, donut charts, sparkline rows).
No glassmorphism, no excessive gradients, no random gold accents.
No generic serif + sans pairing without the brand logic above.
No stock-feeling lifestyle photography; no tourist postcard Mediterranean (no pools, loungers, sea-view balconies).
No botanical flourish unless it is the JURNL mark or a single justified plant in the scene.
anti_ai_rules: No mutated letterforms, fake words, random labels or duplicated nav items.
Every visible word is specified in the prompt; anything else is forbidden.
No symmetric AI-default composition; follow the locked zones.
No HDR glow, no plastic 3D, no over-sharpened textures, no material overload.
No photoreal scene with UI pasted on — the information object belongs to the scene.
The renderer executes the locked translation; it never invents layout, hierarchy or extra elements.

renderer.viewport_mapping: The 9:16 frame height equals the 852-pt JURNL mobile viewport height; the 393-pt viewport is the central 82.05% of the frame width (43-pt environment bleed each side — the same crop the runtime applies to 9:16 plates). All UI, text and data objects stay inside the central 82%; the side bleed carries environment only.
